checks.name: avg_adjusted_price is the average of each line's discounted price
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.product_pricing p left join (select product_id, avg(list_price * (1 - discount_rate)) as adjusted from raw.order_lines group by product_id) r using (product_id) where r.adjusted is null or abs(p.avg_adjusted_price - r.adjusted) > 1e-9

checks.name: avg_list_price is the average list price
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.product_pricing p left join (select product_id, avg(list_price) as listed from raw.order_lines group by product_id) r using (product_id) where r.listed is null or abs(p.avg_list_price - r.listed) > 1e-9

checks.name: every product keeps one row and every line is counted
checks.sql: select (select count(distinct product_id) from raw.order_lines) - (select count(*) from main.product_pricing) + (select count(*) from raw.order_lines) - (select sum(order_lines) from main.product_pricing)
